evidence: Two consecutive seed-42 runs produced identical epoch losses, predictions, and model SHA256 hashes; a seed-43 control run produced different losses and a different hash.
steps: Created a clean CPU-only Python environment with torch 2.7.1 and torchvision 0.22.1.
Ran the local ViT training harness twice with the same seed (42).
Ran the same harness once with a different seed (43) as a control.
Compared the captured outputs and model hashes.
blocking_reason: The reported nondeterminism did not appear here. Same-seed ViT runs were exactly reproducible in this environment, so the issue could not be reproduced from the provided inputs.
